statement: The function returns a result r (it does not fail), and r equals the number of provinces of the graph on the city indices {0,...,n-1}, defined as follows. For indices i and j, say j is reachable from i if there is an integer m >= 0 and a sequence v_0, v_1, ..., v_m of indices in {0,...,n-1} with v_0 = i, v_m = j, and isConnected[v_t][v_{t+1}] = 1 for every t with 0 <= t < m. A province is a nonempty subset S of {0,...,n-1} such that (a) for every i,j in S, j is reachable from i, and (b) for every i in S and every j not in S, j is not reachable from i and i is not reachable from j. Then r is the number of distinct provinces.
preconditions: Let n = len(isConnected). The input is valid: 1 <= n <= 200; for every i with 0 <= i < n, len(isConnected[i]) = n; for every i,j with 0 <= i,j < n, isConnected[i][j] is either 0 or 1; for every i with 0 <= i < n, isConnected[i][i] = 1; and for every i,j with 0 <= i,j < n, isConnected[i][j] = isConnected[j][i].
